manualReview.summary: Stalk-lesion processed matrix and day-10 contrast verified
manualReview.note: GEO provides GSE229838_Processed_data_file.txt.gz, and sample annotations map to day-10 stalk-lesion minus sham in the registered orientation. The PMC paper is open, but its accessible supplement does not provide a complete same-contrast author DE table.
reviewFlags: Legacy source has no committed checksum manifest; verification is structural rather than byte-pinned.

Author Fig. 2A legend (PMC11127955) states the RNA-seq DEG heatmap used n = 3 PEL and n = 2 Sham; the text separately notes an unidentified Sham outlier "not analyzed" (Fig. S2I, supplement not retained). The registered contrast retains all three Sham libraries; which library the authors omitted is not established.
